name: Webtoons
about: A series on webtoons.com, one archive per episode, oldest first, carrying on from the last episode taken. Fetched with Webtoon-Downloader.

fields.label: Start at episode
fields.help: Only for the first run: the number the series' list shows beside the episode (#12) to start from. Blank starts from the first. After that, each run carries on from the last episode taken.
